about-me-p1: I'm a passionate Data Analyst and Business Intelligence Developer originally from Uzbekistan, currently based in London, UK. I specialize in transforming complex business and financial data into actionable insights through tools like Power BI, SQL Server, Excel, and Python. With a solid understanding of data modeling, financial reporting, and performance analytics, I help organizations uncover hidden trends, monitor KPIs, and make smarter, data-driven decisions. My work blends technical accuracy with business awareness — turning data into visual stories that inform strategy and improve efficiency.
about-me-p2: I design and develop interactive dashboards, automated financial reports, and ETL workflows that streamline how data moves from raw sources to clear visual insights. I’ve worked with data across domains like sales, marketing, and finance, focusing on improving forecasting accuracy, cost analysis, and profitability tracking. I’m deeply curious about how data drives business performance, and I continuously refine my skills in data visualization, Power Query, DAX, and financial modeling. My mission is simple yet powerful: <1>Transform data into clarity, and clarity into business growth.</1>
web-dev-p: I explore and analyze datasets using SQL, Python, and Excel to uncover trends, correlations, and opportunities that help businesses make informed, data-driven decisions. My focus is on accuracy, storytelling, and translating data into clear business value.
seo-description: I develop modern, interactive dashboards in Power BI that transform raw data into powerful visual insights. From executive overviews to department-level analytics, I create dynamic data models and intuitive visuals that simplify complex metrics.
blog-description: I design and automate financial dashboards that track revenue, expenses, ROI, and performance KPIs. Using tools like Excel, Power BI, and DAX, I deliver real-time financial insights that improve budgeting, forecasting, and decision-making.
data-modeling: I build efficient ETL pipelines to clean, transform, and integrate data from multiple sources. With Power Query and SQL Server, I ensure accuracy, scalability, and automation in every step of the data process.
